run_simulation_with_gui: run a pybullet physics simulation in GUI mode with a loaded URDF cube model
load_urdf_model: load a URDF file into the pybullet physics simulation with a fixed base at a given position
change_dynamics_mass: change the mass of a rigid body in pybullet using changeDynamics to enable a floating base
set_gravity: set the gravity vector in the pybullet physics simulation to control object movement
step_simulation_loop: step the pybullet simulation forward in a loop while the physics server is connected
